question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **who**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Who is used as a **relative pronoun** here.
 
• Relative pronouns refer back to **a noun phrase or pronoun **that has just been mentioned. 
 
• The relative pronoun is the **subject/object of the relative clause**, so we do not repeat the subject/object.
 
• Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5 is **option 2**.
